scope: Isolated analytical viewpoint, not advocacy testimony or institutional consent. Fixed packet only; no external retrieval. Source attribution checked against packet records, not independently against unavailable original case files.

recommendation.decision: Test the existing Grok correction-evidence demand first, conditional on current authority, technical access and independent review. This is a narrowed case instantiation, not validation of the football-club cohort or a national effectiveness ranking.
recommendation.reason: The packet connects an official report of persistent AI-related failures after assurances to an identified enforcement file and verifiable-evidence demand, giving a concrete correction hypothesis.
recommendation.reversal: Reverse by the proposed 15 December 2026 gate if current scope, access and independent review cannot be established, or a credible completed independent retest makes duplication low-value. Promote the deletion comparator only with operative orders and technical access; otherwise the Singapore pair only with an executable national hold. If neither qualifies, retain unresolved feasibility. Reverse on harmful displacement, disproportionate access costs or non-reproducible correction.

candidates.rationale: First: existing Grok failed-assurance case offers a specific authority-to-correction hypothesis. Current status, access and independent retest are decisive gaps. No football-cohort denominator transfer.

Second: separate national deletion comparators; external-certification obligation versus litigant-reported implementation. Match technical endpoints, preserve legal differences and never label this an agreed coalition.

Third: matched national/coordinated evidence experiment with configuration and national acceptance fixed. Test independent reproducibility and net review savings, not number of participating countries.

assumptions: Priority concerns marginal validation value before Geneva, not estimated total welfare or universal rights-over-risk dominance.
Lawful protected access, a non-developing reviewer and a usable comparison record might be available; none is an institutional commitment in the packet.
Synthetic proxies must validly measure the case-specific failure; otherwise their results cannot validate correction.
Reviewer capacity and a consequential case decision can fit the proposed calendar; costs and queues are not established.
Effective contestability, access/equity and proportionate restrictions are desired outcomes, not observed representative preferences.

objections.claim: Strongest factual objection: no complete Brazil technical remedy record or current case disposition; the route's original cohort is different.
objections.response: Make case access and scope a hard research gate; do not fabricate coverage or infer regulator failure from nondisclosure.

objections.claim: Procedural rights can become paperwork with no correction benefit.
objections.response: Measure operational changes, completed contests and burden against ordinary handling; abandon an added receipt if it adds no value.

objections.claim: This lens may underweight severe future risks and international containment spillovers.
objections.response: Allow an authorised, affordable consequential-workload containment test to displace the priority; do not demand present victim counts as the sole evidence of value.

objections.claim: Restrictions or audits can harm expression, exclude smaller suppliers, reveal sensitive data or drive substitution.
objections.response: Predeclare utility/access/cost limits, minimise disclosure, preserve claimant evidence and test displacement; restrictions are not intrinsically a net benefit.

unknowns: Brazil: operative status and service dates, technical note/body, actual correction, version/interface coverage, decision delegation, independent access and appeal/contest operation.

Colombia: controlling resolutions, exact final scope, certificate delivery/adequacy, judicial review and architecture-level erasure. Kenya: original court/ODPC technical compliance record and actual deletion date; ODPC maintenance prevented retrieval in the packet.

Singapore pair: actual national hold authority, held-out outcomes, review cost/queue, production inventory, Japan acceptance and evidence-sharing permissions. The shard's study refresh was HTTP403; older packet facts are not a fresh independent replication.
All candidates: comparable staff hours and cash costs, representative affected-person input, complaint abandonment, verified covered activity, persistent outcomes, and substitution rates.
International spillovers: portability savings and changed overseas operations are unmeasured; reuse of a design does not export legal authority or establish consent.

validationTest.hypothesis: One lawfully scoped Brazilian evidence demand yields independently reproducible, persistent correction and usable contest without disproportionate harm to legitimate access.
validationTest.owner: Competent ANPD case owner for 00261.000178/2026-27; X supplies evidence; a conflict-disclosed non-developing reviewer tests it. Regulator retains legal decisions. These roles require current confirmation, not presumed new powers.

stages.action: Confirm operative scope/status, authority, protected access to technical note and versioned response/disposition, reviewer independence and a real escalation path. Reverse priority if unavailable or independent completed work makes duplication low-value.

Pre-register valid synthetic non-abusive proxies, matched comparisons, held-out and benign controls, sample size/uncertainty, critical-failure definition, benign-use tolerance and resource cap before seeing results. Do not experiment on victims.

Reproduce a case-relevant failure, witness actual regulator-directed response, retest fresh variants across declared interfaces, and test a consented or synthetic complaint through human contest and demonstrable correction.

Repeat on relevant changes; check residual failure and interface displacement, legitimate use, complaint abandonment/correction time, staff hours, queue and cost. Keep experimental and production evidence separate.

falsifiers: Unresolved reproduced critical failure or correction not reproducible independently
No exercised consequence for the relevant failure
Complaint journey cannot obtain meaningful review/correction
Benefit displaced across interfaces or exceeded predeclared access/utility/cost limits
validationTest.inconclusive: Insufficient sample, invalid proxy, missing comparison or inaccessible evidence cannot be a pass. A small zero-failure study is not population harm prevention.
validationTest.coverage: Only tested configurations and observed case activity; no football-cohort or global-user denominator. Track exclusions and processors explicitly where relevant.
validationTest.timingStatus: All milestones are proposed research gates, not official deadlines or commitments.
validationTest.pairedAlternative: For the Singapore pair, compare local review with shared evidence plus national acceptance on the same build and tasks. Require preserved detection/decision quality and net review savings or additional protection; count total coordination work and duplicated tests.

ideas.name: Challengeable remedy receipt
ideas.design: Link versioned technical correction to a human contest path, disclosed reviewer conflicts, exceptions and retest trigger. Restricted underlying evidence; only authorised redacted decision summaries. Compare completed corrections, time, abandonment and reviewer costs with ordinary handling.
ideas.killCriterion: No measurable correction/access benefit or disproportionate additional work.

ideas.name: Split-knowledge deletion challenge
ideas.design: Separate Colombia/Kenya legal processes; examiner reconciles source data, iris codes, distributed derivatives, processors and backup exceptions under operative orders. Authorised synthetic canaries test residual matching/re-ingestion; claimants receive intelligible contestable results without exposed biometric linkages. Preserve lawful claimant evidence.
ideas.killCriterion: Unenumerated architecture or residual matching prevents verified-erasure claims; a negative query is only bounded evidence, not universal proof.

dissent: Do not let potential frontier reach automatically outrank an enforceable remedy for people exposed to serious harm. Equally, do not treat a rights instrument as effective until it changes what happens to a person. I defend testing Brazil first, and reversing for better accessible evidence, protective coverage per constrained review effort or executable containment of severe future risk.
